open_points.subject: build_budget_view dependency-boundary note
open_points.text: build_budget_view: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction by beginning a transaction on the store through PortalStore.begin, which returns a PortalTransaction, with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, because the transaction type provides no context-manager protocol and entering one raises TypeError before any read. It MUST read the selected or active version and its plans only through the budgets repository PortalTransaction.budgets returns, the project expenses only through the expenses repository PortalTransaction.expenses returns, and the section progress only through the project_tracking repository PortalTransaction.project_tracking returns; then close that read transaction by exactly one PortalTransaction.rollback, marking it closed before it derives any total, and use no legacy transaction-level method.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace dotted method references such as PortalStore.begin and PortalTransaction.rollback with prose naming the declared operations without dotted navigation.

open_points.text: build_progress_view: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, read the active version and its plans only through the budgets repository PortalTransaction.budgets returns and the section progress only through the project_tracking repository PortalTransaction.project_tracking returns, then close that read transaction by exactly one PortalTransaction.rollback, marking it closed before it derives any total or weighted percentage, and use no legacy transaction-level method.

open_points.subject: build_project_overview dependency-boundary note
open_points.text: build_project_overview: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST compose the budget, expense, progress and payment views by calling their builders build_budget_view, build_expense_view, build_progress_view and build_payment_view, and MUST read the project photos only through the progress_photos repository PortalTransaction.progress_photos returns and the project sections only through the project_sections repository PortalTransaction.project_sections returns in a transaction of its own. Every transaction it or those builders open MUST be assigned explicitly, never entered as a context manager, and closed by exactly one PortalTransaction.rollback. It MUST NOT hold its own transaction open while calling another builder, so the reads are sequential and never nested; the number of reads follows from the composition and is not fixed at one. No legacy transaction-level method may be used.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
